scope: Every active series in sources/catalog.csv plus the hand-curated production-critical set. Static economic metadata only; refresh outcomes live in the append-only event log (output/data_quality/refresh_events.jsonl).

status_definitions.not_yet_released: The cache contains every observation expected by the as-of date, while a later reference period is complete but its scheduled release date has not arrived.
status_definitions.source_unavailable: The source endpoint or upstream publication is unavailable at the latest attempted refresh.
status_definitions.ingestion_failure: The source was reachable, but retrieval, parsing, transformation, or persistence failed.
status_definitions.validation_failure: Data were retrieved but failed schema, range, uniqueness, timing, or other declared validation rules.
status_definitions.stale_observation: At least one observation should have been released by the as-of date but is absent from the monitored cache.
status_definitions.manually_overridden: A documented manual value currently supersedes the automated source.
status_definitions.successfully_updated: The monitored cache includes the latest reference period expected by the as-of date and no later failure overrides that success.
status_definitions.unassessed: Static registry fields use null until the monitoring view is built. Unassessed is never a dashboard status.
